<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>A 64-bit ripple carry adder with pipelining stages.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for addition operation.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand B.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal indicating the availability of the result.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State IDLE.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE1">State STAGE1.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE2">State STAGE2.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE3">State STAGE3.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE4">State STAGE4.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE5">State STAGE5.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE6">State STAGE6.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE7">State STAGE7.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE8">State STAGE8.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE9">State STAGE9.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE10">State STAGE10.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE11">State STAGE11.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE12">State STAGE12.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE13">State STAGE13.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE14">State STAGE14.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE15">State STAGE15.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE16">State STAGE16.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE17">State STAGE17.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE18">State STAGE18.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE19">State STAGE19.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE20">State STAGE20.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE21">State STAGE21.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE22">State STAGE22.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE23">State STAGE23.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE24">State STAGE24.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE25">State STAGE25.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE26">State STAGE26.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE27">State STAGE27.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE28">State STAGE28.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE29">State STAGE29.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE30">State STAGE30.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE31">State STAGE31.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE32">State STAGE32.</parameter>
    </paramter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="pipe_i_en" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for input enable signal.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_adda" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for input operand A.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_addb" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for input operand B.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_carry_in" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for carry-in signal.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[0]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[1]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[2]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[3]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[4]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[5]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[6]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[7]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[8]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[9]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[10]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[11]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[12]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[13]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[14]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[15]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[16]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[17]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[18]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[19]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[20]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[21]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[22]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[23]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[24]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[25]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[26]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[27]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[28]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[29]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[30]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_sum[31]" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_carry_out" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for carry-out signal.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_o_en" width_description="[31:0]">Pipeline register for output enable signal.</reg>
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the rising edge of the clock or active low reset
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                pipe_i_en <= 32'd0;
                pipe_adda <= 32'd0;
                pipe_addb <= 32'd0;
                pipe_carry_in <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[0] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[1] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[2] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[3] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[4] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[5] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[6] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[7] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[8] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[9] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[10] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[11] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[12] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[13] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[14] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[15] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[16] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[17] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[18] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[19] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[20] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[21] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[22] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[23] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[24] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[25] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[26] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[27] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[28] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[29] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[30] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_sum[31] <= 32'd0;
                pipe_carry_out <= 32'd0;
                pipe_o_en <= 32'd0;
            end else begin
                pipe_i_en <= {pipe_i_en[30:0], i_en};
                pipe_adda <= {pipe_adda[30:0], adda[31]};
                pipe_addb <= {pipe_addb[30:0], addb[31]};
                pipe_carry_in <= {pipe_carry_in[30:0], pipe_carry_out[31]};
                
                // Calculate sum and carry-out for each stage
                pipe_sum[0] <= pipe_adda[0] + pipe_addb[0];
                pipe_sum[1] <= pipe_adda[1] + pipe_addb[1] + pipe_carry_in[0];
                pipe_sum[2] <= pipe_adda[2] + pipe_addb[2] + pipe_carry_in[1];
                pipe_sum[3] <= pipe_adda[3] + pipe_addb[3] + pipe_carry_in[2];
                pipe_sum[4] <= pipe_adda[4] + pipe_addb[4] + pipe_carry_in[3];
                pipe_sum[5] <= pipe_adda[5] + pipe_addb[5] + pipe_carry_in[4];
                pipe_sum[6] <= pipe_adda[6] + pipe_addb[6] + pipe_carry_in[5];
                pipe_sum[7] <= pipe_adda[7] + pipe_addb[7] + pipe_carry_in[6];
                pipe_sum[8] <= pipe_adda[8] + pipe_addb[8] + pipe_carry_in[7];
                pipe_sum[9] <= pipe_adda[9] + pipe_addb[9] + pipe_carry_in[8];
                pipe_sum[10] <= pipe_adda[10] + pipe_addb[10] + pipe_carry_in[9];
                pipe_sum[11] <= pipe_adda[11] + pipe_addb[11] + pipe_carry_in[10];
                pipe_sum[12] <= pipe_adda[12] + pipe_addb[12] + pipe_carry_in[11];
                pipe_sum[13] <= pipe_adda[13] + pipe_addb[13] + pipe_carry_in[12];
                pipe_sum[14] <= pipe_adda[14] + pipe_addb[14] + pipe_carry_in[13];
                pipe_sum[15] <= pipe_adda[15] + pipe_addb[15] + pipe_carry_in[14];
                pipe_sum[16] <= pipe_adda[16] + pipe_addb[16] + pipe_carry_in[15];
                pipe_sum[17] <= pipe_adda[17] + pipe_addb[17] + pipe_carry_in[16];
                pipe_sum[18] <= pipe_adda[18] + pipe_addb[18] + pipe_carry_in[17];
                pipe_sum[19] <= pipe_adda[19] + pipe_addb[19] + pipe_carry_in[18];
                pipe_sum[20] <= pipe_adda[20] + pipe_addb[20] + pipe_carry_in[19];
                pipe_sum[21] <= pipe_adda[21] + pipe_addb[21] + pipe_carry_in[20];
                pipe_sum[22] <= pipe_adda[22] + pipe_addb[22] + pipe_carry_in[21];
                pipe_sum[23] <= pipe_adda[23] + pipe_addb[23] + pipe_carry_in[22];
                pipe_sum[24] <= pipe_adda[24] + pipe_addb[24] + pipe_carry_in[23];
                pipe_sum[25] <= pipe_adda[25] + pipe_addb[25] + pipe_carry_in[24];
                pipe_sum[26] <= pipe_adda[26] + pipe_addb[26] + pipe_carry_in[25];
                pipe_sum[27] <= pipe_adda[27] + pipe_addb[27] + pipe_carry_in[26];
                pipe_sum[28] <= pipe_adda[28] + pipe_addb[28] + pipe_carry_in[27];
                pipe_sum[29] <= pipe_adda[29] + pipe_addb[29] + pipe_carry_in[28];
                pipe_sum[30] <= pipe_adda[30] + pipe_addb[30] + pipe_carry_in[29];
                pipe_sum[31] <= pipe_adda[31] + pipe_addb[31] + pipe_carry_in[30];
                pipe_carry_out <= pipe_sum[31][31]; // Carry-out for the last stage
                pipe_o_en <= pipe_i_en[31];         // Output enable signal
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        The module implements a 64-bit ripple carry adder with pipelining stages. It includes several registers to enable the pipeline stages and synchronize the input enable signal (i_en). These registers are controlled by the clock (clk) and reset (rst_n) signals.
        The sum values for each pipeline stage are calculated by adding the corresponding input operands and carry signals. The output enable signal (o_en) is updated based on the pipeline stages and synchronized with the clock (clk) and reset (rst_n) signals.
    </implementation>
</module>
